custom_preconds: Logged in as Owner; on the blank Create Role page (/administration/roles/new); Settings parent toggle OFF.

custom_steps_separated.content: Toggle the Settings parent ON, then toggle App Settings ON.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The 6 Settings sub-rows are shown and App Settings reads ON.

custom_steps_separated.content: Toggle App Settings OFF (it is the only enabled sub).
custom_steps_separated.expected: With no sub enabled the section auto-collapses: the Settings parent toggle reads OFF and all 6 sub-rows are removed from the DOM.

title: Turning off the last Settings sub auto-collapses the section
